extracted.name: Easy Pork Chops for the Slow Cooker
extracted.description: This slow cooker pork chop recipe uses cream of mushroom soup, onion soup, and ranch dressing mix for an easy, savory dinner that's a snap to prepare.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of onion soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Spread 1/2 of the onion slices in the bottom of the slow cooker. Arrange 5 pork chops on top. Repeat layering with remaining onion and pork chops.
Pour both condensed soups and water over pork chops and onion. Sprinkle dressing and soup mixes over top, then season with salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 1/2 to 5 hours or High for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).
